spy-bull-dog-1110.head: de32596d
spy-bull-dog-1110.scope: A rear cast on QAEnemy with Sneak on cost 10 IS, matching the tooltip. It broke Sneak ('You stop sneaking'), made no direct hit, published 710 +10 for 0.5 s, ticked once for 10 (5000->4990) and removed the record, with nothing on QAFriend. Without Sneak, against a friend, from the front, blocked and far, each cast was refused with no IS spent.

sneak-movement-speed.head: 55dfaab0
sneak-movement-speed.scope: 151's four records (998 +10, 1027 +5, 1143 +5, 1047 +5) were on CSR and QAFriend at login. The stock run speed was 1.093x with 151 loaded, 1.000x after ?qaunload and 1.090x after ?qaload. With Hyper-Speed it was 1.543x, then 1.444x after unloading 151 and 1.093x after dismissing Hyper-Speed. The Sneak-gait isolation was not checked natively.
